chapter_seo_title: Dao-Guai-Yi-Xian Ch. 513 – Li Huowang reads the Zuowandao kill report
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang reviews the Office’s devastating Zuowandao purge records. But with Bai Lingmiao still missing and Dice still alive, his greatest enemy may be his own weakness.
og_title: The Supervisory Office Has Been Busy
og_description: Li Huowang gets a front-row seat to the carnage—but the one name missing from the death list is the one he fears most.
twitter_title: Dice’s forces are crumbling, but he’s still holding Bai Lingmiao.
twitter_description: Li Huowang pores over the Office’s kill ledgers, but a chilling warning from Nangong reminds him: in the capital, he is completely alone.

lore_anchors.definition: The government bureau responsible for policing supernatural phenomena and rogue cultivators in the Dao-Twisted World. They operate under strict mandates that forbid involvement in mundane imperial politics.
The highest-ranking echelons of the Zuowandao, named after mahjong tiles. The Three Yuans correspond to the three Dragon tiles; the Four Joys correspond to the four Wind tiles.
The leader of the Zuowandao, identified by his mahjong-tile alias. He is the primary antagonist in the current arc.
The head of the Supervisory Heavenly Office. He handles the most dangerous threats directly, including Dice.
A rare individual whose very existence is tied to a specific concept or deity; they cannot survive long in a foreign nation. Zhuge Yuan uses this fact to reassure Li Huowang.
